object.attr: as implemented: the client shows only that the server failed, and the client's log holds standard error. Absolute, so that a relative or inherited root is visible; whatever the log level, so that `--log-level ERROR` can't hide it (review Q42).
object.description: When the MCP server exits with status 2, the MCP server shall write the reason and the absolute path of the refused folder to standard error, whatever the log level.
